dedupeText: country music concert portrait cowboy hat western wear concert lighting marquee typography smiling man acoustic guitar strap stage bokeh the black cowboy hat acts as a dark frame for the subject s face the light blue shirt provides a high value contrast against the dark background the patterned guitar strap leads the eye from the bottom right toward the center the marquee style text mimics the look of stage lights or theater signs combine a high contrast western portrait with marquee style dotted typography to create a classic country music aesthetic

recipe.visualDefinition: A medium close-up portrait of a smiling man in traditional western attire, set against a dark, out-of-focus stage background with warm bokeh highlights. The composition is topped with two lines of marquee-style typography featuring dotted patterns.
coreVisualRelationships: The black cowboy hat acts as a dark frame for the subject's face.
The light blue shirt provides a high-value contrast against the dark background.
The patterned guitar strap leads the eye from the bottom right toward the center.
The marquee-style text mimics the look of stage lights or theater signs.
coreInvariants: Black felt cowboy hat with a wide brim
Warm, directional stage lighting creating highlights on the face
Dark background with orange/red bokeh circles
Patterned textile guitar strap with geometric motifs

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Centered medium close-up, subject occupies the lower two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's smile and eyes, framed by the hat brim.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the marquee text at the top, moves down to the face, and follows the guitar strap toward the bottom right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Dark areas around the hat and the upper corners provide space for the typography.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep black and dark shadows in the background and hat.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Pale sky blue of the button-down shirt.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Warm orange and red bokeh lights; earthy red and white in the strap pattern.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High contrast between the dark hat/background and the bright shirt/teeth.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid cool-toned background lights; keep bokeh in the warm spectrum.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Bold slab serif and condensed sans-serif
letterConstructionRules: Glyphs are constructed from a series of small, circular dots or stars resembling light bulbs.
The primary line uses a wide, heavy slab-serif structure.
The secondary line uses a taller, condensed sans-serif structure.
characterSpecificRedesigns: Serifs are blocky and formed by clusters of dots.
Internal 'bulbs' are evenly spaced along the center of each stroke.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A wide, heavy marquee slab serif paired with a condensed, thinner marquee sans-serif for hierarchical contrast.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the light-bulb aesthetic of the original.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A high-quality photograph of a middle-aged man with a warm smile, wearing a black cowboy hat and a light blue button-down shirt. He has a patterned western guitar strap over his shoulder. The background is a dark stage with soft, warm orange bokeh light circles. Lighting is bright on the face, coming from the side.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two lines of centered uppercase text at the top. The top line should be a wide slab-serif marquee style with white star-shaped dots. The second line should be a condensed sans-serif marquee style with smaller orange-tinted dots.

verificationChecks: Is the hat a matte black felt?
Are the bokeh lights warm-toned and out of focus?
Does the text have the dotted marquee light effect?
Is the shirt a crisp light blue?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the artist
Exact brand logos on the microphone or clothing
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the marquee dots are distinct and not a solid line.
Check that the guitar strap pattern looks woven, not printed.
Verify the smile looks natural and matches the concert lighting.
Confirm the background is sufficiently dark to make the text pop.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a high-contrast western portrait with marquee-style dotted typography to create a classic country music aesthetic.
